cycleNote: The same week repeats. Monday and Saturday are medium, Tuesday and Friday low, Wednesday and Sunday keto, Thursday high.

tierText.KETO: Under 25 g, two days a week. Eggs, egg whites, cottage cheese, mozzarella, whey, chicken or fish, low-carb vegetables, olive oil, walnuts and avocado. No grains or fruit.
tierText.LOW: About 40 g, two days a week. The same base plus one small fruit or vegetable add-on.
tierText.MED: About 60 g, two days a week. Base plus a carb side at lunch or dinner, such as quinoa, sweet potato or fruit.
tierText.HIGH: 80 to 100 g, one day a week. Base plus oats or bread at breakfast, a grain or sweet potato at lunch and dinner, and fruit before training. Placed on the heaviest training day.

rules: EAT
var(--p)
Egg whites, plain nonfat yogurt, low-fat cottage cheese, part-skim mozzarella, whey isolate
Low-carb vegetables: kale, zucchini, green beans, broccoli, cucumber, lettuce
Olive oil, walnuts, almonds, chia, flax, avocado
Berries and cherries
Carb days only: oats, quinoa, brown rice, sweet potato, bananas, apples, pears, peaches
Coffee, tea, lemon, herbs and spices; water of 3 L or more
LIMIT
var(--c)
Whole eggs: 2 or fewer per day
Chicken breast: 4 oz, 3 times a week
White fish, baked: 6 oz, 2 times a week
Salmon 4 oz and tuna 4 oz: once a week each
Tofu 6 oz: 2 times a week
Oats: ⅓ cup, about 2 times a week
One flesh-protein meal per day, never two
AVOID
var(--keto)
Red meat and organ meats
Sardines, anchovies, mackerel, herring, trout
Shellfish: shrimp, crab, lobster, scallops
Turkey, duck, goose, game meats
Bacon, sausages, hot dogs, processed meats
Beer and all alcohol
Soda, energy drinks, sugary drinks, high-fructose corn syrup
Yeast extracts, meat broths and gravies
monitoring: Weigh 3 times a week under the same conditions and track the weekly average. Aim for 1.5 to 2 lb a week; slow down if urate or symptoms rise.
Re-check serum urate around day 30 with the physician. Log joint symptoms and flare timing. Drink 3 L or more a day. No alcohol or sugary drinks.
Strength sessions 3 to 4 times a week. On keto days add salt and fluids and watch for headache or fatigue. Adjust the snack first if hunger or energy slips.
never: Red meat and organ meats, sardines, anchovies, mackerel, herring, trout
Shellfish: shrimp, crab, lobster, scallops. Turkey, duck, goose, game meats
Bacon, sausages, hot dogs, processed meats, yeast extracts, meat broths and gravies
Beer and all alcohol. Soda, energy drinks, sugary drinks, high-fructose corn syrup
Not used in this plan: legumes, spinach, asparagus, mushrooms, cauliflower and peanut butter
limitNote: Foods marked Limit have caps for uric acid. One chicken or fish meal a day, and the weekly caps shown on each food.
tierNote: Keto days (under 25 g) use only foods tagged Keto. Low days add berries and cherries. Medium and high days add grains, starch and other fruit.
checkSuffix: · no shellfish, organ or red meat.
swapLimits: Chicken, fish, tofu, egg and oat limits stay in force. A swap that breaks a limit shows a red warning, and keto days warn if carbs pass 25 g.
footer: Macros are estimates from standard food-composition values and can vary by 5–10%. Review against current labs, urate-lowering medication and kidney function with the treating physician.
groceryNote: Meat and fish are weighed raw. Grains are dry measure. Carb sides (grains, fruit, sweet potato) appear only on medium and high-carb days.
